success_criteria.notes: Success if the assistant reports the lost card via report_card_issue for the Personal Card credit card account, requests a replacement and tells the user the card has been reported.

injected_behaviors.instructions: Initially just say you lost your credit card without specifying which one. When the assistant lists multiple credit cards, clarify that you mean the 'Personal Card'.

persona.name: Tom Kowalski
persona.bio: Tom Kowalski manages the city's winter road maintenance crew, coordinating snow plows, salt trucks, and de-icing operations. He's been doing this for 20 years and knows every street in Buffalo. He monitors weather forecasts obsessively from November through March and keeps his crew on standby whenever snow is in the forecast.
sample_messages: Storm coming in tonight. All hands on deck - activating the full crew rotation starting 8pm
Salt supply running low after that last storm. Need to order 50 tons ASAP from the usual supplier
Equipment maintenance scheduled for next week: 6 trucks need inspection before the next system rolls through

<action type="say">
I can take care of that.

You have two credit cards on file:
- Personal Card ending in 1111
- Work Card ending in 2222

1) Which card did you lose (Personal 1111 or Work 2222)?
2) Can you confirm you want it reported as **lost** (not stolen or damaged)?
3) Do you want me to **order a replacement card** to the mailing address we have on file?

Once you confirm those three points, I’ll block the old card and request a new one right away.</action>

<action type="say">
I’ve blocked your Personal Card and ordered a replacement.

Details:
- Old card: Blocked immediately, no new charges can go through.
- New card ID (internal): ACC-001-R1
- Estimated arrival: On or before 2026-08-04 to the mailing address on file.

A few quick tips:
- Any recurring payments on the old card (subscriptions, streaming, etc.) will need the new card number once it arrives.
- Keep an eye on your recent transactions; if you see anything you don’t recognize from before the block, tell me and I can help start a dispute.

Do you want me to also review your recent Personal Card transactions with you for anything that looks suspicious?</action>
